Azumarill.name: Belly Drum
Azumarill.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Azumarill.description: Huge Power plus Belly Drum: one boost turns every hit into a knockout.

Snorlax.name: Belly Drum
Snorlax.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Snorlax.description: Maxes its Attack in one turn and tries to bulldoze through with Return.

Clefable.name: Belly Drum
Clefable.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Clefable.description: Magic Guard means Life Orb costs it nothing: Belly Drum, heal, then hit hard.

Swampert.name: Curse
Swampert.label: Curse sweeper
Swampert.description: Stacks Curse boosts and heals with Rest, turning its bulk into a slow, heavy sweep.

Gengar.name: Destiny Bond lead
Gengar.label: Destiny Bond lead
Gengar.description: Taunts the foe's lead and takes a sweeper down with it using Destiny Bond, safe behind Focus Sash.

Rhyperior.name: Rock Polish
Rhyperior.label: Rock Polish sweeper
Rhyperior.description: Doubles its Speed with Rock Polish, then sweeps with Life Orb Stone Edge and Earthquake.

Tentacruel.name: Swords Dance
Tentacruel.label: Swords Dance sweeper
Tentacruel.description: Trades its usual spinning role for Swords Dance and physical hits.

Dusknoir.name: Trick Room
Dusknoir.label: Trick Room setter
Dusknoir.description: Flips the speed order with Trick Room, then its slow, strong attacks move first.

Steelix.name: Torment
Steelix.label: Torment staller
Steelix.description: Torments the foe so it can't repeat a move, hiding behind Substitute while Toxic wears it down.

Crobat.name: Nasty Plot
Crobat.label: Nasty Plot sweeper
Crobat.description: Boosts with Nasty Plot and uses its blazing Speed for a special sweep.

Charizard.name: Bellyzard
Charizard.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Charizard.description: Belly Drums behind a Substitute, then sweeps once its Salac Berry kicks in.
